description: Structural zero for meat, poultry, fish, eggs, dairy, oils, sugar and alcohol; other classes use the median fiber-to-carbohydrate ratio only when both source tables lack fiber values.
Rice products: cooked indica-rice porridge with reported total dietary fiber.
Wheat products: the wheat-based noodle cake from sizzling beef noodles, with reported total dietary fiber.
Whole and coarse grains: oats, cereal flakes and unsweetened mixed-grain porridge.
Tubers: potato chips and potato rings.
Leafy vegetables: pak choi, young pak choi, baby Chinese cabbage, tatsoi and mustard greens.
Brassica vegetables: red cabbage, Brussels sprouts and kale.
Fruit vegetables and pods: cherry tomato, sweet pepper, multicolored pepper, okra, pattypan squash, autumn cucumber and chestnut pumpkin.
Root and stem vegetables: pickled turnip, pickled mustard root, pickled radish strips and carrot puree.
Legumes: seasoned and spiced broad-bean products.
Mushrooms: dried tea-tree, golden-cap, shaggy-mane, termite and porcini mushrooms.
Fresh fruits: red apple, plum, prune, winter jujube, red grape, grapefruit, rambutan, dragon fruit and durian.
Dried fruits: dried figs, dried lychees and dried black dates.
Sweet baked foods: biscuits, mooncakes, sachima and chocolate pies.
